'''BO-LT5''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid]] that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Like all [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] BO-LT5 was built by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], and like all other R5 units, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] stood 0.96 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. BO-LT5's body plating was [[Color/Legends|red]] and white in color, while its head was colored brown. During the war, BO-TL5 was offered for sale by the [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] [[80-T5]], who worked selling a range of goods from a small stall within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At the time it was offered for sale, the astromech's head was decorated with a depiction of a mouth full of [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It's true that an astromech is a starfighter pilot's best friend! BO-LT5 is no exception!|Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
BO-LT5's first appeared as a purchasable companion for players in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] released by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment in [[2010]]. The droid can be bought for 200 station cash, a premium in-game currency players have to buy with real money. Given that BO-LT5's purchase is entirely optional, this article makes no assumptions about if it was bought. The droid's name spells out the word "Bolts".
